## Linked Issue

Refs #1895

## Scope Summary

- R10 only: replace the native root-thread show-more button in `src/frontend/src/components/article/ArticleCommentsVirtualList.vue` with `FsusUiButton` from the existing public `@/fsusui/button` adapter. Use `native-type="button"` and the public `link` variant.
- Preserve `showMoreRootThreads`, initial/render bounds, thread slicing, hidden count, conditional visibility, source order, child event payloads/forwarding, ARIA, and list/wrapper layout. This control had no disabled/loading binding or focus ref. No component instance is treated as an HTMLElement and no DOM lookup is added.
- Remove only duplicated action-control base/hover/focus CSS. No other production file, handler, security/privacy cleanup, permission, schema, registry, frozen evidence, receipt, test, shared wrapper, or FsusUI source is changed.
- Exact base: `codex/r10-comment-list-base-d5773ef9` at `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b`; head: `codex/1895-r10-show-more` at `940bc9c45d5887cf18daa147be92f484114d41ab`. +/** Caller-owned opaque request token. Use a fresh object for every request/retry.
+ * Pass the same object on its presentation; targetKey is never a slug or URL.
+ * The host owns admission, AbortController, transport, selection and focus return.
+ */
+export interface ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest
+{
+    readonly targetKey: string;
+    readonly signal: AbortSignal;
+}
+
+/** Plain, already-admitted display data only. Null means the fact is unavailable.
+ * openInNewTab must be the host's authoritative canonical action, preserving its
+ * editor context. This component neither resolves routes nor grants admission.
+ */
+export interface ArticleInternalLinkPreviewContent
+{
+    readonly title: string | null;
+    readonly excerpt: string | null;
+    readonly statusText: string | null;
+    readonly sectionText: string | null;
+    readonly openInNewTab: (() => void) | null;
+}
+
+export type ArticleInternalLinkPreviewPresentation = Readonly<{
+    request: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest;
+}> & (
+    | Readonly<{ state: 'ready'; content: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewContent; }>
+    | Readonly<{ state: 'loading' | 'error' | 'empty' | 'aborted' | 'stale'; }>
+);

+<template>
+    <ElPopover
+        :visible="visible"
+        :persistent="false"
+        placement="bottom-start"
+        width="min(22rem, calc(100vw - 2rem))"
+        role="dialog"
+        title="内部链接预览"
+        @update:visible="handleVisibility"
+    >
+        <template #reference>
+            <ElButton
+                text
+                native-type="button"
+                :disabled="targetKey === null"
+                :aria-expanded="visible"
+                aria-haspopup="dialog"
+                data-internal-link-preview-request
+                @pointerenter="requestHover"
+                @focus="requestPreview('focus')"
+                @click="requestPreview('action')"
+                @keydown.esc.stop.prevent="dismiss('escape')"
+            >预览内部链接</ElButton>
+        </template>
+
+        <section
+            v-if="visible"
+            class="article-internal-link-preview"
+            data-internal-link-preview
+            :aria-labelledby="titleId"
+            :aria-busy="display?.state === 'loading'"
+            @keydown.esc.stop.prevent="dismiss('escape')"
+        >
+            <h2
+                :id="titleId"
+                dir="auto"
+            >{{ content?.title || '内部链接预览' }}</h2>
+            <template v-if="content">
+                <p dir="auto">{{ content.excerpt ?? '摘要不可用。' }}</p>
+                <dl>
+                    <div>
+                        <dt>状态</dt>
+                        <dd dir="auto">{{ content.statusText ?? '不可用' }}</dd>
+                    </div>

+/** Caller-owned opaque request token. Use a fresh object for every request/retry.
+ * Pass the same object on its presentation; targetKey is never a slug or URL.
+ * The host owns admission, AbortController, transport, selection and focus return.
+ */
+export interface ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest
+{
+    readonly targetKey: string;
+    readonly signal: AbortSignal;
+}
+
+/** Plain, already-admitted display data only. Null means the fact is unavailable.
+ * openInNewTab must be the host's authoritative canonical action, preserving its
+ * editor context. This component neither resolves routes nor grants admission.
+ */
+export interface ArticleInternalLinkPreviewContent
+{
+    readonly title: string | null;
+    readonly excerpt: string | null;
+    readonly statusText: string | null;
+    readonly sectionText: string | null;
+    readonly openInNewTab: (() => void) | null;
+}
+
+export type ArticleInternalLinkPreviewPresentation = Readonly<{
+    request: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest;
+}> & (
+    | Readonly<{ state: 'ready'; content: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewContent; }>
+    | Readonly<{ state: 'loading' | 'error' | 'empty' | 'aborted' | 'stale'; }>
+);

+<template>
+    <ElPopover
+        :visible="visible"
+        :persistent="false"
+        placement="bottom-start"
+        width="min(22rem, calc(100vw - 2rem))"
+        role="dialog"
+        title="内部链接预览"
+        @update:visible="handleVisibility"
+    >
+        <template #reference>
+            <ElButton
+                text
+                native-type="button"
+                :disabled="targetKey === null"
+                :aria-expanded="visible"
+                aria-haspopup="dialog"
+                data-internal-link-preview-request
+                @pointerenter="requestHover"
+                @focus="requestPreview('focus')"
+                @click="requestPreview('action')"
+                @keydown.esc.stop.prevent="dismiss('escape')"
+            >预览内部链接</ElButton>
+        </template>
+
+        <section
+            v-if="visible"
+            class="article-internal-link-preview"
+            data-internal-link-preview
+            :aria-labelledby="titleId"
+            :aria-busy="display?.state === 'loading'"
+            @keydown.esc.stop.prevent="dismiss('escape')"
+        >
+            <h2
+                :id="titleId"
+                dir="auto"
+            >{{ content?.title || '内部链接预览' }}</h2>
+            <template v-if="content">
+                <p dir="auto">{{ content.excerpt ?? '摘要不可用。' }}</p>
+                <dl>
+                    <div>
+                        <dt>状态</dt>
+                        <dd dir="auto">{{ content.statusText ?? '不可用' }}</dd>
+                    </div>
+                    <div>
+                        <dt>目标章节</dt>
+                        <dd dir="auto">{{ content.sectionText ?? '不可用' }}</dd>
+                    </div>
+                </dl>
+            </template>
+            <p
+                v-else
+                role="status"
+                aria-live="polite"
+            >{{ statusText }}</p>
+            <div class="article-internal-link-preview__actions">
+                <ElButton
+                    native-type="button"
+                    :disabled="!content?.openInNewTab"
+                    data-internal-link-preview-open
+                    @click="openTarget"
+                >在新标签页打开</ElButton>
+                <ElButton
+                    text
+                    native-type="button"
+                    data-internal-link-preview-dismiss
+                    @click="dismiss('action')"
+                >关闭预览</ElButton>
+            </div>
+        </section>
+    </ElPopover>
+</template>
+
+<script setup lang="ts">
+import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, useId, watch } from 'vue';
+
+import type {
+    ArticleInternalLinkPreviewPresentation,
+    ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest
+} from './ArticleInternalLinkPreview.types';
+
+export type {
+    ArticleInternalLinkPreviewContent,
+    ArticleInternalLinkPreviewPresentation,
+    ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest
+} from './ArticleInternalLinkPreview.types';
+
+const props = defineProps<{
+    targetKey: string | null;
+    request: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest | null;
+    /** Null clears content and withdraws an already presented token. Retry with
+     * a fresh object; provide loading/ready together with the new request.
+     */
+    presentation: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewPresentation | null;
+}>();
+
+const emit = defineEmits<{
+    request: [intent: Readonly<{ targetKey: string; trigger: 'hover' | 'focus' | 'action'; }>];
+    dismiss: [intent: Readonly<{
+        request: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest;
+        reason: 'escape' | 'action' | 'outside';
+    }>];
+    /** Notification after the supplied action; do not open the target again. */
+    open: [request: ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest];
+}>();
+
+const titleId = `article-internal-link-preview-${useId()}`;
+// Retain only the current displayed presentation, never hidden target content.
+const display = shallowRef<ArticleInternalLinkPreviewPresentation | null>(null);
+const aborted = shallowRef(false);
+const dismissedRequest = shallowRef<ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest | null>(null);
+const presentedRequest = shallowRef<ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest | null>(null);
+const withdrawnRequest = shallowRef<ArticleInternalLinkPreviewRequest | null>(null);
+let removeAbortListener: (() => void) | undefined;
+
+const visible = computed(() =>
+{
+    const request = props.request;
+    if (!request)
+    {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (request.targetKey !== props.targetKey)
+    {
+        return false;
+    }
+    return !request.signal.aborted && !aborted.value && dismissedRequest.value !== request;
+});
+const content = computed(() => visible.value && display.value?.state === 'ready'
+    ? display.value.content
+    : null);
+const statusText = computed(() =>
+{
+    switch (display.value?.state)
+    {
+        case 'loading': return '正在加载预览…';
+        case 'error': return '预览暂时不可用。';
+        case 'empty': return '暂无可用预览。';
+        case 'aborted': return '预览请求已取消。';
+        case 'stale': return '预览已失效，请重新请求。';
+        default: return '预览不可用。';
+    }
+});
+
+watch([() => props.request, () => props.targetKey], () =>
+{
+    removeAbortListener?.();
+    display.value = null;
+    aborted.value = props.request?.signal.aborted ?? false;
+    const request = props.request;
+    if (!request)
+    {
+        return;
+    }
+    const onAbort = () =>
+    {
+        aborted.value = true;
+        display.value = null;
+    };
+    request.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
+    removeAbortListener = () => request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
+}, { immediate: true, flush: 'sync' });
+
+watch([() => props.presentation, () => props.request, () => props.targetKey], () =>
+{
+    if (!props.presentation)
+    {
+        // Props arrive individually. An initially absent presentation cannot
+        // revoke a new token that has never supplied a matching presentation.
+        if (props.request && presentedRequest.value === props.request)
+        {
+            withdrawnRequest.value = props.request;
+        }
+        display.value = null;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (!visible.value)
+    {
+        display.value = null;
+        return;
+    }
+    // A late response cannot replace the newer currently displayed admission.
+    if (props.presentation.request === props.request && withdrawnRequest.value !== props.request)
+    {
+        display.value = props.presentation;
+        presentedRequest.value = props.request;
+    }
+}, { immediate: true, flush: 'sync' });
+
+function requestPreview(trigger: 'hover' | 'focus' | 'action'): void
+{
+    if (props.targetKey !== null && !visible.value)
+    {
+        emit('request', { targetKey: props.targetKey, trigger });
+    }
+}
+
+function requestHover(event: PointerEvent): void
+{
+    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse')
+    {
+        requestPreview('hover');
+    }
+}
+
+function dismiss(reason: 'escape' | 'action' | 'outside'): void
+{
+    if (!visible.value || !props.request)
+    {
+        return;
+    }
+    const request = props.request;
+    dismissedRequest.value = request;
+    display.value = null;
+    emit('dismiss', { request, reason });
+}
+
+function handleVisibility(nextVisible: boolean): void
+{
+    if (!nextVisible)
+    {
+        dismiss('outside');
+    }
+}
+
+function openTarget(): void
+{
+    const action = content.value?.openInNewTab;
+    const request = props.request;
+    if (!action || !request || request.signal.aborted)
+    {
+        return;
+    }
+    action();
+    emit('open', request);
+}
+
+onBeforeUnmount(() =>
+{
+    removeAbortListener?.();
+    display.value = null;
+});
+</script>
+
+<style scoped>
+.article-internal-link-preview
+{
+    min-inline-size: 0;
+    max-block-size: 60vh;
+    overflow: auto;
+    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+    color: var(--el-text-color-primary);
+}
+
+.article-internal-link-preview h2
+{
+    margin: 0;
+    font-size: var(--el-font-size-base);
+    font-weight: 600;
+}
+
+.article-internal-link-preview p,
+.article-internal-link-preview dl
+{
+    margin-block: var(--fsus-space-3);
+}
+
+.article-internal-link-preview dl > div
+{
+    display: grid;
+    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
+    gap: var(--fsus-space-2);
+}
+
+.article-internal-link-preview dt
+{
+    color: var(--el-text-color-secondary);
+}
+
+.article-internal-link-preview dd
+{
+    margin: 0;
+}
+
+.article-internal-link-preview__actions
+{
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    gap: var(--fsus-space-2);
+}
+</style>

+    <output
+        class="article-search-reveal-status"
+        role="status"
+        aria-live="polite"
+        aria-atomic="true"
+        :aria-label="label"
+    >
+        {{ label }}: {{ statusLabels[presentation.status] }}
+        <template v-if="presentation.status === 'ready' && presentation.precision !== null">
+            · {{ precisionLabels[presentation.precision] }}
+        </template>
+    </output>
+</template>
+
+<script setup lang="ts">
+import type { ArticleSearchRevealPresentation } from '@/services/authoring/articleSearchRevealPresentation';
+
+/**
+ * Read-only command availability, never a focus/viewport success acknowledgement.
+ * The host supplies localized labels and a fresh canonical projection whenever
+ * its command, context, binding or active search lease changes. Raw reasons and
+ * command digests are deliberately not rendered.
+ */
+defineProps<{
+    presentation: ArticleSearchRevealPresentation;
+    label: string;
+    statusLabels: Readonly<Record<ArticleSearchRevealPresentation['status'], string>>;
+    precisionLabels: Readonly<Record<NonNullable<ArticleSearchRevealPresentation['precision']>, string>>;
+}>();
+</script>
+
+<style scoped>
+.article-search-reveal-status
+{
+    display: block;
+    color: var(--el-text-color-secondary);
+    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+}
+</style>
